en: Color image of a busy marina filled with small sailboats and yachts, their tall masts reflecting in the calm water. In the background a large white cruise or passenger ship is docked, and along the right side stand several angular, red‑brown wooden warehouse‑like buildings by the quayside. The sky is clear and blue, giving a bright summer atmosphere typical of a coastal tourist town. No visible printed title or caption appears on the front.
